bank_name: South Bangla Agriculture & Commerce Bank PLC
period_note: SOLO/STANDALONE basis, unaudited. Balance sheet is the 30-September-2023 period-end snapshot (reported), compared against 31-December-2022 (audited). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2023 (the statement's own 'Ol Jan 2023 to 30 September 2023' column); 9-month PAT (459,737,655) and EPS (0.56) match EXACTLY the 9M-2023 comparative column independently printed in this bank's own 2024_Q3.json filing. The filing also prints a discrete 'Ol July to 30 September 2023' column; this reconciles EXACTLY against 9-month-cumulative-minus-H1 using this bank's own 2023_Q2.json (459,737,655-321,490,373=138,247,282, matching the printed discrete-Q3 PAT of 138,247,282 to the Taka) -- confirming, together with 2023_Q1.json/2023_Q2.json, that all three of this bank's FY2023 quarterly filings are mutually and exactly consistent (unlike the small unexplained gaps found across the FY2024 quarters -- see 2024_Q2.json/2024_Q3.json). Asset quality continued modest and improving: classified loans (Note 8.11, Solo) Tk.4,335.46m (NPL 5.11%), essentially flat vs 31-Dec-2022 (Tk.4,031.22m) and consistent with 2023_Q1.json (5.27%) and 2023_Q2.json (4.96%). The loans-and-advances-only provision shortfall (Note 8.10) continued improving: Tk.277.40m (30-Sep-2023), down from Tk.369.90m (Q2) and Tk.370.00m (Q1/Dec-2022) -- the Bank was steadily paying down this specific deferred shortfall through FY2023, referencing the same DOS (CAMS)1157/41(dividend)/2023-2113 letter (25 April 2023) already found in 2023_Q1.json/2023_Q2.json. This FY2023 trajectory (370.0m to 369.9m to 277.4m, ending the year at 355.64m per 2024_Q1.json's comparative) sits in sharp contrast to FY2024's trajectory the following year, which resumed improving through Q1-Q3 2024 (266.7m to 182.7m to 77.4m) before exploding to 6,558.4m in Q4 2024 alone (see 2024_Q1/Q2/Q3.json). Capital adequacy (CRAR/RWA/Tier1/Tier2) disclosures are not part of this quarterly unaudited financial statement.
